## Mark your calendar!

**Date:** 31 August and 1 September, 2026

**Location:** [University of Zurich Main Building](https://www.plaene.uzh.ch/KOL), Room KOL-G-217, Rämistrasse 71, 8006 Zürich, Switzerland

[Registration](https://forms.office.com/e/dTPgBdJDwm){.btn .btn-primary}

The aim of this event is to bring together researchers from different fields of methodological research (including, but not limited to (bio)statistics, psychometrics, econometrics, bioinformatics, machine learning, quantitative methods for ecology, linguistics, etc.) who are interested in meta science on methods research, discuss how new quantitative methods are developed, evaluated and published in our respective fields, and how this process can be improved by sharing our thoughts and experiences across disciplines.

Confirmed keynote speakers include:

- Jean Yang, University of Sydney (Biostatistics / Bioinformatics): [Beyond Rankings: Benchmark-Informed Method Recommendation](/program/talks/j-yang.html)
- Pablo Meyer Rojas, IBM (AI / Systems Biology): [The Do's and Don'ts of Benchmarking in Systems Biology](/program/talks/p-meyerrojas.qmd)
- Anne-Laure Boulesteix, Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (Biostatistics): [Evaluating statistical methods: a metascientific journey](/program/talks/al-boulesteix.qmd)
- Tim Morris, Novartis (Biostatistics): [Trust and trustworthiness of research on biostatistical methods](/program/talks/t-morris.qmd)
- Jessica Kay Flake, University of British Columbia (Psychological Methods): [Using Research Synthesis to Navigate the Multiverse](/program/talks/jk-flake.qmd)
- Björn Siepe, Philipps-Universität Marburg (Psychological Methods): [Simulation studies in psychology: State of the art, problems, and potential solutions](/program/talks/b-siepe.qmd)

Abstract submission is closed, registration is still open. The number of on-site places is limited. Registrations will be accepted on a first-come, first-served basis until June 15th. Attendance is free of charge. The symposium will also be live-streamed (registration also required). Researchers from all methodological research disciplines are welcome.

Join us to share your work, to exchange ideas, and to shape the future of meta science on methods research! 

This event is co-sponsored by the [Center for Reproducible Science and Research Synthesis](https://www.crs.uzh.ch/en.html) of the University of Zurich, the [Swiss National Science Foundation](https://www.snf.ch/en), [Stadt Zürich](https://www.stadt-zuerich.ch/), [Kanton Zürich](https://www.zh.ch/), Hochschulstiftung Universität Zürich, and [Zurich R courses](https://www.zhrcourses.uzh.ch/en.html).
